3. In suit, plaintiff by an application dated 18-52004 sought to amend his plaint under Order VI Rule 17 of the Code for incorporating some facts regarding dispossession during pendency of the suit and relief regarding recovery of khas possession which was allowed by trial Court and affirmed in revision by the impugned order. Hence the Petition. 

 12. On going to materials on record it transpires that it is the definite case of plaintiff that during pendency of suit he was dispossessed. Therefore, he sought for incorporation of some facts relating to his dispossession during pendency of suit and recovery of khas possession.
